BOOK NOW

STUNNING VIEWS AND FAMOUS GRANFONDO MONUMENT 'IL LOMBARDIA'.

Everybody that is into cycling knows the last monument of the year, "Il Lombardia".
We designed a unique Cycling Holiday basing us on a central location for you to discover the beauty of Lake Como, watch the pros in the last monument of the year and ride the Gran Fondo "Il Lombardia" the next day.
A unique route in an extraordinary landscape. 109,3 km and 2,300 m in vertical altitude gain.
The perfect combination of ascents, descents and steep spurts that ensures fun and enjoyment to all participants.


Your race entry is secured through the OFFICIAL TOUR OPERATOR of Gran Fondo Il Lombardia.

This mean that by booking this trip you will have GUARANTEED ENTRY to the event.

What's included

  • 5 Nights in the stunning 4-star Hotel Il Corazziere situated between Como & Lecco. A few km away from the start of the famous Ghisallo climb.
  • 5 Spectacular days of cycling
  • 5 Buffet breakfast at the hotel
  • Lunch available after each ride with sandwiches, fresh fruits, tea, coffee, and drink.
  • Airport transfers including bike and luggage transfers at the below details. Private transfers can be also organised at a supplement.
  • All ground transportation including to watch the pro race, to the Gran Fondo and to evening restaurants.
  • Every day guided cycling routes by our ex pro, experienced and friendly guides.
  • Ever day PRO experience with supported vehicle
  • Snack & water on route
  • GPX files sent in advance
  • Support during the Gran Fondo event on Sunday (feed zones, mechanical assistance)
  • Pro tips by our ex pro staffs
  • Washing maching available at accommodation
  • Guaranteed Gran Fondo Entry with choice of starting grid, including Grid 1 & Grid 2.
    Gran Fondo entry that can be done with us at starting from €115.
    We are TOUR OPERATOR of Gf Il Lombardia! With us the entry is guaranteed and you will get: race number, sportful body fit pro jersey, technical vest, technical gadget, race kit, breakdown assistance, medical care during the event, feeding zones, broom wagon service, pasta party at the finish

What's not included

  • Flights ​
  • Dinners - organised with a few great restaurants
  • Single room limited availability at €50/night
  • Gran Fondo Entry. Can be purchased directly with us and entry is guaranteed. 
  • Bike rental from €260 for the entire trip​.
  • Massages available with our professional masseuse
  • Travel insurance (compulsory)

Airport Transfers

From Milan Bergamo BGY (ITALY)
Airport transfer leaves at 11:00 am

11/10/2027
To Milan Bergamo BGY (ITALY)
Airport transfer leaves at 9:00 am (1h15 journey)

TRIP AT GLANCE

START & FINISH LOCATION: Lake Como

DAYS RIDING: 5 days

TOTAL DISTANCE 407 km

GROUP SIZE: 15/20 max (2 groups on the road each day divided on abilities)

LEVEL Open to anybody

LONGEST DAY: Day 4 - Gran Fondo Il Lombardia

ROUTE

DAY TO DAY BREAKDOWN

GPX files will be sent before the trip.

SHORT RIDE TO CIVIGLIO, COMO
37km | 450mt

Welcome to Lake Como.
After grabbing some lunch and getting the bike ready, we head out for a short 40 km ride to Civiglio, a nice climb in Como overlooking the lake

GRAN FONDO RECCE
85km | 1500mt

Today we get a chance to test out the legs and route of Gran Fondo Il Lombardia.
We climb Sormano, descent into Nesso, Bellagio and climb the Ghisallo for then come back to the hotel. that, we head back.

VARENNA AND EAST SIDE OF THE LAKE
92km | 1100mt

We head to the most famous climb of the lake, Madonna del Ghisallo, which we will do again on Sunday from the other side. After that, we descent into Bellagio, take the ferry across and come back from the west side of the lake. Garda.

COFFEE RIDE INTO LECCO
42km | 610mt

Today a nice coffee ride into Lecco before the big day tomorrow.

GRANFONDO IL LOMBARDIA
110km | 1700mt

It's the big day! Ride like a hero/

LEAVING DAY

See you next time!

ACCOMODATION

HOTEL IL CORAZZIERE *****

Featuring an outdoor heated swimming pool, The 4-star hotel is surrounded by a large, well-kept garden. It features a traditional restaurant and an extensive wine and liquor cellar. The professional team of friendly staff will be delighted to welcome you and make your stay special. Guests can also use the free internet point and free car park. Rooms here have beautiful views of the pine forest and of the Lambro River. Guests can make free use of the property's gym. On-site facilities include a relax area with a sauna and sensory showers.

BIKE RENTAL

There are many options available, depending on your measures and budget we work with you to find the best bike for you. From standard mechanical groupset and alloy wheels to electric shifting and carbon wheels.

Road E-bikes are also available.

FRAMESET Bianchi, Guerciotti, Wilier, De Rosa, Ktm

GRUPPO: Sram Rival/Force AXS, Shimano 105, Ultegra, Durace Di2 and Mechnical

PEDALS: Bring your own

SADDLE: Selle Itala

WHEELSET:  Alloy, Carbon

MATTEO CIGALA

Founder & Head Coach

Since founding Cigala Cycling Tours in 2015, Matteo has been leading over 10 tours per year. A former pro and current amateur racer, Matteo is the 2022 European Champion Gran Fondo.

AMEDEO TABINI

Tour Guide Leader

A former pro cyclist, Amedeo is a cycling tour guide for a decade. It is one of the most experience guides that you will ever find, counting almost over 1000 days on tours.
Finally, Amedeo is a qualified massage therapist.

MARINE LENEHAN

Tour Guide, Nutritionist, Massage Therapist & Yoga Teacher

Current pro cyclist, former Gravel World Champion and European Gran Fondo Champion, Marine is also a qualified sports nutritionist, massage therapist and yoga teacher.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need to bring my own bike, or can I rent one?

You’re welcome to bring your own bike, or rent one for the week. After booking, you will receive a form to fill out via email. You can let us know there and in the case you want to rent, you will see an option to fill up details for your measurements. 

What fitness level do I need for this trip?

This trip suits Beginner, Intermediate and Expert riders. The core Lake Como routes are approachable for most fitness levels — the Gran Fondo is the only day that demands solid fitness, however is optional.

Are support vehicles included?

Yes every day the support vehicles will be there with snacks and water on route. You can also leave spare layers inside for the descents and anything you might need.

Is there a single room supplement?

Yes, there is the option for you to take a single room. Once you have booked within 48 hrs you will receive a form to complete and you can let us know your room preference.

If you’re planning to ride the Gran Fondo, some dedicated climbing preparation makes a real difference — sustained climbs like this reward riders who’ve built specific endurance rather than just general fitness. If you’d like a structured plan built around this trip, visit our cycling coaching page and Matteo can help you put together a plan based on your current level and the time you have before you travel.

What should I pack for this trip?

Beyond your usual riding kit, bring layers as the trip is held in October. Make sure you also pack your rain gear. You might not need it, however best to have it in the van, just in case. Our full guide to packing for a European cycling holiday covers everything else you’ll need for the week.
